from collections import Counter
def min_window(s, t):
    need = Counter(t)
    missing = len(t)
    lo = start = end = 0
    for hi, c in enumerate(s, 1):
        if need[c] > 0: missing -= 1
        need[c] -= 1
        if missing == 0:
            while lo < hi and need[s[lo]] < 0:
                need[s[lo]] += 1
                lo += 1
            if not end or hi - lo <= end - start:
                start, end = lo, hi
            need[s[lo]] += 1
            missing += 1
            lo += 1
    return s[start:end]
